draft.emotion: bustling and open, standing in the middle of a lively town square
notes: Partial false friend: to say 'a nice place' or 'a place to visit' in general, French uses 'un endroit' or 'un lieu', not 'une place'.
Also used for a ticket or admission to a cinema, theatre, or concert (e.g. 'acheter deux places de cinéma').
